backtest_feasibility.message: No champion declared: three archive-verified forecast origins now test 2023 after training on 2014 and 2018, but they represent only one distinct held-out election.
validation_constraints: Only three completed direct presidential elections exist in the current constitutional era: 2014, 2018, and 2023.
Only one distinct held-out presidential election is possible after the minimum two-election training window; the promotion gate requires three.
The available direct-presidential history spans nine years; the reliability gate requires twenty.
All three forecast origins test the same 2023 election, so they are not three independent election holdouts.

model.freshness: exploratory long-range scenario; candidate and timing uncertainty
model.headline: The opposition-nominee scenario leads, but Erdoğan or another governing nominee retains a material path; Türkiye has only one held-out election, not a validated model.
